answer: The sparrow chain is verified at intake and ridge publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 12 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 12 epochs old, anchored at a whisper checkpoint. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 30 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
